nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: Calls run() and maps the result to a process exit code; error messages are sanitized anyhow reports.

nodes.label: run()
nodes.desc: Determines pattern type (regex/glob/exact/fixed), computes smart case, constructs Config, builds the matcher and starts the scan.

nodes.label: smart case
nodes.desc: The search is case-insensitive unless the user forced a flag or any pattern contains an uppercase character.

nodes.label: construct_config
nodes.desc: Translates Opts into Config: extension RegexSet, time filters, colors, strip-cwd rules, --exec command set.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.desc: One immutable struct shared by walker, worker threads and receiver; built once in run().

nodes.label: Opts (clap derive)
nodes.desc: Every flag lives here; about text states the contract: respect gitignore, skip hidden, smart case.

nodes.label: -u / --unrestricted
nodes.desc: Alias for --no-ignore --hidden, borrowed from ripgrep; re-adds ignored and hidden files to the walk.

nodes.label: default_num_threads
nodes.desc: Uses available_parallelism, capped at 64 threads to keep startup overhead low on huge machines.

nodes.label: build_patterns
nodes.desc: Dispatches on PatternType; empty pattern list yields MatchAll so a bare fd lists everything.

nodes.label: RegexSet matcher
nodes.desc: regex::bytes::RegexSet over the file name; with --and semantics a path matches only if all patterns hit.

nodes.label: Glob matcher
nodes.desc: globset with literal_separator(true) so * does not cross path separators; single glob avoids GlobSet overhead.

nodes.label: FixedStrings / ExactStrings
nodes.desc: --fixed-strings uses memchr substring search; --exact anchors and compares whole names.

nodes.label: MatchAll
nodes.desc: Trivial matcher returning true, used when no pattern is given.

nodes.label: WorkerState::scan
nodes.desc: Builds walker and channel, installs a Ctrl-C handler when printing colors, joins sender and receiver threads.

nodes.label: WorkerState
nodes.desc: Holds Patterns, Config plus quit_flag and interrupt_flag for clean cancellation.

nodes.label: build_walker
nodes.desc: One place where ignore options are wired into WalkBuilder, including multiple search roots.

nodes.label: build_overrides
nodes.desc: Turns --exclude patterns into an Override (each prefixed with !) applied on top of ignore rules.

nodes.label: WalkBuilder wiring
nodes.desc: git_ignore/git_global/git_exclude, require_git, .fdignore custom file, global ignore file, max_depth, same_file_system, threads.

nodes.label: spawn_senders
nodes.desc: walker.run builds one closure per thread; batch limit 0x100 (or 1 for --exec) gives backpressure.

nodes.label: BatchSender
nodes.desc: Groups WorkerResults into an Arc<Mutex<Vec>> batch so the channel carries pointers, not per-entry messages.

nodes.label: bounded(2 * threads)
nodes.desc: crossbeam channel capacity scales with the thread count; a full channel pauses the walkers.

nodes.label: worker filter closure
nodes.desc: Checks filters in cheap-to-expensive order: name, extension, type, owner, size, mtime; quits early on quit_flag.

nodes.label: patterns.matches_path
nodes.desc: First check because it needs no syscalls; matches the file name (or full path with --full-path).

nodes.label: extension filter
nodes.desc: -e exts compiled once into a case-insensitive RegexSet like \.rs$ and tested against the file name bytes.

nodes.label: FileTypes::should_ignore
nodes.desc: Implements -t d/f/l/x/e/s (dir, file, symlink, executable, empty, socket) from the entry's FileType.

nodes.label: OwnerFilter
nodes.desc: --owner uid:name parsing and matching; Unix-only, needs entry metadata.

nodes.label: SizeFilter::is_within
nodes.desc: Parses +500m/-2g style bounds with SI and binary prefixes; metadata is fetched only when a size constraint exists.

nodes.label: TimeFilter::applies_to
nodes.desc: --changed-within/--changed-before accept durations, timestamps, dates or @epoch; all constraints must pass.

nodes.label: prune (WalkState::Skip)
nodes.desc: --prune returns Skip after a match so the walker never descends into matched directories.

nodes.label: ReceiverBuffer
nodes.desc: poll() loop drains batches; Buffering up to MAX_BUFFER_LENGTH=1000 entries, then stream().

nodes.label: Buffering vs Streaming
nodes.desc: recv() uses recv_deadline; a 100 ms timeout flips the mode so big trees start printing immediately.

nodes.label: stop() + sort
nodes.desc: If the whole walk finished inside the buffer window, results are sorted before printing; --max-results/quiet exit early.

nodes.label: DirEntry
nodes.desc: OnceCell-cached metadata and style; broken symlinks arrive as walk errors and get converted back into entries.

nodes.label: print_entry
nodes.desc: Applies hyperlink, colors, --format template and separators into a BufWriter stdout lock.
